text_block_list.text:
—Late spring. The throne still rests high 
in the heavens.

"Even so, it's definitely within reach. 
I've done everything I needed to do."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then. I cannot have you thinking this 
End-of-Century Overlord is the same as 
back during the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I burn up spontaneously in the flames of 
self-praise, only to rise stronger like a 
phoenix.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, come at me. Don't you dare leave me 
all alone.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I still want to savor the remnants of 
youth. An insatiable romance.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Then just as you wish—I'll take you down.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I won't let you run away with it. I will 
overtake you."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oh, you guys are—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let's have a good race, Opera O-chan. You 
truly are strong. However—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"We don't stand in the gates just to be 
defeated. We will surpass you, without 
fail."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Top Road-san, Ayabe-san! I knew that if 
anyone would answer my summons, it would 
be the two of you.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. And now, let me introduce a new 
comrade to all my old friends here.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Step forward, my friend! You who have at 
last reached this stage! Your name is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Doto-chan...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, Top Road-san, Ayabe-san, thank you for 
having me today~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I've finally made it this far. It's thanks 
to Opera O-san, and also...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Thanks to Top Road-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Mine?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes, because at the Fan Appreciation 
Festival, everyone told me to "move 
forward with confidence."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I gained a little bit of 
confidence, won a GⅡ, and made it to this 
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Is that right! I'm just glad I could be of 
help!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to today. As rivals, 
that is.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ri... val?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No no no, I still have a loooong way to 
go. Today, I'm just here to watch and 
learn~.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! It may indeed be a bit too heavy 
a burden for Doto just yet.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Top Road-san, Ayabe-san. Just taking on 
the two of you alone is more than enough 
for me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us enjoy this. A thrilling 
reunion, the first since last year's 
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —I won't let you. —I won't let it happen.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes, I will win, without fail...!

"A race is strictly an individual 
competition. Yet, somehow, this almost 
feels like a 2-on-1."

Narita Top Road and Admire Vega, having 
honed their strength against one another. 
Will either of their legs be able to reach 
the strongest Opera O?
